Rep. Timmons is spot-on demanding transparency from the SEC’s Gensler-era circus. The agency’s ETH flip-flops—from Hinman’s 2018 non-security declaration to Gensler’s secret “Ethereum 2.0” probe—expose the bureaucratic rot that stifles innovation. The CLARITY Act (H.R. 3633) exists to torch this exact regulatory whiplash by codifying clear rules for digital commodities, ending the SEC’s “regulation by lawsuit” charade.

Gensler’s SEC wasted taxpayer dollars playing hide-the-ball with FOIA requests while greenlighting ETH ETFs they’d previously investigated. That’s not oversight—it’s incompetence.

Congress must pass the CLARITY Act to lock in Trump’s America-first crypto framework, replacing Biden-era chaos with enforceable standards that protect investors without crushing technological leadership.
